howToApply: Visit the NRSC official website: https://www.nrsc.gov.in/Career_Apply
Register online from 01.08.2026 (1000 hrs) to 21.08.2026 (1700 hrs).
Fill in all required details carefully in the online application form.

Upload scanned copies of required documents: recent passport-size photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40KB, 110x140px), signature (jpg/jpeg, max 20KB, 200x50px), SSC/10th certificate, Intermediate/Diploma, Graduation certificate and mark sheets, Post Graduation certificate and mark sheets, GATE/NET score card (for JRF posts), caste/category certificate if applicable.
After filling the form, you will be redirected to BHARATKOSH payment gateway to pay the application fee of ₹250/-.
On successful payment, download the e-acknowledgement for future reference.
After successful payment, login again to the e-recruitment portal for final submission of the application.
Download the personalised registration confirmation form containing Name, Registration No., Advertisement No., and Post Code.
Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post.

howToApply: Visit the official TSLPRB website: www.tgprb.in
Register using your mobile number as the User ID.
Select the notification(s) and post(s) you wish to apply for.
Note the applicable fee and complete payment via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking.
Log in and fill in Part-I of the Application Form.
Scan and upload your passport-size photograph and specimen signature as a single JPG file (30 KB–100 KB).
Review all entries, confirm via OTP sent to your registered mobile number, and submit Part-I.
Download and print the generated Part-I application form in PDF.

Candidates who qualify the Preliminary Written Test (SI Civil/RSI/SPF SI/SFO/Deputy Jailor group) — or, for PC Mechanic/Driver and ASI FPB (which have no Preliminary Written Test), at the appropriate later stage — must revisit the website to submit Part-II along with scanned certificates/documents.
Download and retain a copy of the final submitted form for future reference.
